audience: ecommerce teams managing orders and inventory in PlentyONE

useCases.title: Review unpaid orders
useCases.text: Find recent unpaid orders, inspect their details and translate status IDs into the statuses used by your team.

useCases.title: Find stock that needs attention
useCases.text: Review physical, reserved and net stock by variation and warehouse, then inspect the related product variations.

useCases.title: Review a customer’s orders
useCases.text: Find a contact by email, inspect their account details and review their orders before responding to a customer query.

useCases.title: Add an internal order note
useCases.text: Review existing comments and add an internal note to the selected order, keeping it hidden from the customer unless you explicitly request visibility.

useCases.title: Change an order’s status
useCases.text: Inspect an order and available statuses, confirm the target status, then apply it. A status change can trigger configured customer emails, stock bookings and other event procedures.
